description: This file contains a unit test for a queue implementation using Google Test framework. It tests basic queue operations such as insert, post, remove, extract, and flush.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A template class representing a queue, used here with int type for testing.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item into the queue with a specified priority or key.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts or signals that an item is available in the queue.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the queue based on its key.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts an item from the queue, possibly based on priority or key.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the queue.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the queue, possibly allowing operations.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, possibly preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue.
